topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I thought the day couldn’t get any better. Emails, texts—everyone was confirming. The arrangements, the jokes, the carefully picked playlist. I imagined walking in, the lights flashing on, and everyone shouting. But now, the house is quiet. The texts have stopped, and my phone feels heavier in my pocket. The silence is thick, and the plans that once sparkled in my mind now just echo in the empty spaces. I keep replaying the messages, wondering what went wrong, trying to salvage a moment that was supposed to be full of joy.
